datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on November 03, 2022
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of November 03, 2022, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20221103]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (ICEYE SAR) was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map actual flood extent on November 3, 2022 following typhoon-induced rainfall and storm surge. The resulting flood polygons with area measurements represent observed inundation footprints derived from radar backscatter analysis, enabling post-event impact assessment of affected agricultural and infrastructure areas.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite imagery processing using ICEYE synthetic aperture radar to map actual flood extent and inundation areas across the Philippines following typhoon impact on November 3, 2022.
